records.observation: Defaults COLOR_XOR_BORDER, overlap inclusion1, minheight2,separation4. Setters border/minheight unchecked; six case-sensitive display names map0..5 (fit,overlap incl,cumulative incl,overlap excl,cumulative excl,base-aligned cumulative excl); unknown1,null throws. Public draw/contains independently order times and rows. drawForward converts x, DrawnBox covers/set BEFORE Insets, then converts rows/adds Insets, clips relevant x bounds0/width-1. Tracks original inset width and clippedwidth, inclusive height; no full-outside/negative-size/overflow guard. Gets actual Shadow weight array and sorts in place. Modes2/4/5 compute bottom-up heights reverse order: mode2 inclusive normalized by SUM OF VISIBLE inclusive ratios, mode4/5 exclusive times full pixelheight unnormalized; round via +0.5f castint, clamp allocation to remaining vertical space, hidden/nonpositive heights0; stores each pixelheight and total into Shadow. Zero visible ratio sum not guarded. Overlap1/3 sort chosen ratio, height=ratio*height+.5 castint without clamp; width starts full insetwidth, shrinks by4 when current roundedheight>=previous, hiddenheight0. Fit0 sorts inclusive, equal height floor(height/visibleCount) clamped minheight, caps to remaining space; zero visible count divide not guarded. Paint overlap rectangles centered, positive cached width/height only, x clipping0..imageWidth; cumulative/fit stack full clipped width, mode4 centers used total, modes2/5/0 bottomaligned. Does not fill unused background. Border only if >=1 category draw, then always returns1 even no category painted; covered returns0. Default XOR sees last category foreground, supplied border color passed separately. contains first rejects outside ORIGINAL rectangle then applies Insets, uses cached pixel dimensions and current array order WITHOUT sorting/recalculation or visibility/searchable check. Overlap tests forward (reverse paint priority), halfopen per-category rectangle with clipped x. Stacked modes reverse iterate stored heights, mode4 adjusts using stored total, checks y band only AFTER initial pre-Inset x test: horizontal inset margins can remain selectable. Returns Category only ornull, no shadow/border fallback. Changing mode/visibility/transform/Insets without repaint may leave stale geometry; DrawnBox suppression can skip recomputation. No finite/raster correctness claim. This is the final previously unread base/ class in the receipt inventory; it does not close non-base Java, Python, native or whole-model gates.
